# Brightwater Corporate Center - After-Hours Switchboard Call Log
Shift: Swing (16:00 - 24:00) | Date: 03/18/2026 | Desk Officer: Sunita Hendricks, Badge #412

## Tenant Directory Reference
| Suite | Tenant Name | Primary Contact | Emergency Routing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Brightwater Logistics | Raymond Nguyen | On-call Operations Mgr |
| 310 | Clearwater Financial | Nadia Ibrahim | VP Operations (Direct Line) |
| 405 | Halcyon Biotech | Frank Del Rio | Lab Safety Coordinator |

## Incoming Call Summary
- 18:22 - Caller: Wayne Ortiz (Courier Express). Inquired about after-hours freight elevator access for a scheduled document drop at Clearwater Financial. Advised that loading dock access closes at 18:00 and directed him to contact the tenant representative directly.
- 19:40 - Caller: Raymond Nguyen (Brightwater Logistics). Requested HVAC override for Suite 200 conference rooms until 23:00. Logged request in building automation system and verified tenant authorization PIN.
- 20:15 - Caller: Trevor Barnes (Metropolitan Fire Alarm Systems). Requested security to place the building fire alarm panel in test mode for water riser flow inspections. Guard verified test credentials and placed panel on test with central dispatch.
- 21:05 - Caller: Maria Whitfield (Stonebridge Cleaning Services). Left message for Nadia Ibrahim regarding custodial access to Clearwater Financial Suite 405 scheduled for 06:00 tomorrow.

## Action Items and Escalations
- HVAC override entered and confirmed active for Suite 200 through 23:00.
- Switchboard transferred one urgent facilities call directly to property management answering service.

errors.quote: place the building fire alarm panel in test mode for water riser flow inspections.
errors.explanation: Security switchboard protocols require recording the specific test duration or scheduled end time when placing a life safety fire alarm panel into test mode, so guards know when normal monitoring must resume.
errors.fix: place the building fire alarm panel in test mode for 60 minutes for water riser flow inspections.

errors.quote: regarding custodial access to Clearwater Financial Suite 405 scheduled for 06:00 tomorrow.
errors.explanation: According to the tenant directory reference table, Clearwater Financial occupies Suite 310, not Suite 405 (which belongs to Halcyon Biotech).
errors.fix: regarding custodial access to Clearwater Financial Suite 310 scheduled for 06:00 tomorrow.
